name: Character Editor Test
description: GUI test of the character editor in rpg_plus: opens rpg_plus_game's characters, shows the slime's localized name, adds a character with the New button, types its name, health and RPG charset into the form, saves; the game must know the character with its stats and name at once. The new file and the locale edits are removed again. Activated by --itest=characters_editor_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first).
